title: Hairy Cell Leukemia Thriver
content: Hairy Cell Leukemia ThriverRadical Remission ProjectMay 8, 20241 min readJohn Henry is a leukemia thriver and co-author of the book, Empower Trip. He has been in remission for over 3 and a half years. His diagnosis of cancer began a journey of learning and an understanding that cancer does not define you. After discovering the Radical Remission Project and the 10 healing factors, John not only implemented them into his life but was inspired to help others. He became a Certified Radical Remission Instructor and Coach IN 2019. Now, he is a retired educator for over 30 years, a co-author of Empower Trip - A Teens Guide to Finder their Inner Star Power, and a K-12 education consultant.Click here to connect with John on Facebook, or email him directly at henryjohn37@gmail.com.John's book, Empower Trip, addresses emotional health for middle and high school students.
